newsitem.title: UK: UK's Parity takes over German IT firm.
newsitem.headline: UK's Parity takes over German IT firm.

text.p: British information technology services group Parity Plc said on Tuesday that it had bought a private German information technology consultancy firm for 500,000 stg (DM 1.2 millon). The German firm, TPI Gesellschaft fur technische Projekte in der Informatik mbh (TPI), has over 20 consultancies in the telecom and information serivices market in Stuttgart. TPI's pretax profit for the year ended December 31, 1995 stood at DM 0.56 million on a turnover of DM 4.7 million.
The company said the acquisition was funded from its own cash resources. --London Newsroom +44-171-542 7717
